instruction: Turn on deinterlacing and set the method to Yadif.

criteria.script: async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/vlc/vlcrc', format: 'key_value', key: 'deinterlace', default: '-1' } ] }); return data[0]; }
async () => { const data = await window.surfgym.get_configs({ criteria: [ { file: '.config/vlc/vlcrc', format: 'key_value', key: 'deinterlace-mode', default: 'auto' } ] }); return data[0]; }
